coverageNote: Disk enumeration matched the expected 5 units / 33 files exactly. Units: the domain root directory (index + cx + 7 flat feature files = 9 files) and the four sub-domain directories 06.01 (6), 06.02 (6), 06.03 (7), 06.04 (5). All 33 files were processed in full in a sandbox; decision-bearing regions (Behavior, States, Edge Cases, Deep Think, Decisions, Open Questions, Cross-Cut Details, Role Matrices) were read verbatim. Mechanical passes run across all 33 files: Open-Question owner/deferral-target completeness (every row), cross-file decision-id citation resolution, numeric/default parameter conflict detection, untestable-normative-language scan, declared-status vs parent-Children-table reconciliation, Role Matrix / Role Lens cell-population check, and CX map-vs-detail integrity. This is an unusually rigorous spec: the vague-term scan returned 30 hits across 841KB and none were normative statements (all were rationale prose); every tunable is stated as a number with a range, an owner and a justification; all 106 Open Question rows carry an owner and a deferral target except 6 struck-through/RESOLVED rows where none is required. No implementer-simulation forced invention survived the devil's-advocate pass: the two candidates (the days-half range of the At-Risk grace knob in 06.01.01, and the per-preset make-up minimum in 06.01.03) are both covered by tracked owner questions (06.01.01 Q-04, 06.01.03 Q-01). No blocking findings. The dominant defect is systemic rather than local: inline [PENDING - Step 5] markers were never re-pointed when the /ideate-discover Step 5 run completed, even though the Open Questions tables were systematically re-pointed at the same time.

findings.claim: education-lessons-mentorship-cx.md CX-05 states that a term boundary is the ONLY point at which a recurring series may end. The same CX-05 section, four lines later, and 06.01.01's own States table both enumerate other termination paths. The statements cannot all hold and neither carries a marker.
findings.evidence: education-lessons-mentorship-cx.md:146-148 — "The academy layer **bounds** 06.01 in four places: term calendar (bounds published availability **and the materialization horizon** — the term boundary is the only point at which a recurring series may end, via the **re-enrolment checkpoint**, 06.01.01 D-05/DT-06)". CONTRADICTED BY (a) the same section at education-lessons-mentorship-cx.md:152-154 — "A fifth binding surfaced in Step 5: the **no-fault closure cascade** — closing the building (06.10 D-11) forces the same-day remedy on every in-flight series with no notice period, because the room is gone."; (b) 06.01.01-lesson-slot-booking-recurring-series.md:164 States row — "| **Lapsed** | At-Risk grace elapsed, or a missed re-enrolment window | Student: 'Tuesday 17:00 was released on 30 Jul'"; (c) 06.01.01:105 edge case — "**At-Risk grace elapses (2 occurrences / 14 days, no top-up)** | Series → **Lapsed**. Slot class returns to `open` and re-enters the market."; (d) 06.01.01:165 — "| **Completed** | Fixed-count series hit its last occurrence |". The cited child decision is correctly narrower: 06.01.01:232 D-05 — "Re-enrolment is an Operator-configurable gate, **default off**, and is the only mechanism by which **a term end** may release a tenancy". The CX file dropped the 'a term end' scope qualifier, converting a scoped claim into a universal one.
findings.forcedInvention: An implementer reading CX-05 as the domain-level summary would suppress the non-payment (At-Risk → Lapsed) release path and the fixed-count Completed path, or would have to invent which of the two sources governs.

findings.claim: education-lessons-mentorship-cx.md asserts the academy no-fault closure cascade as a settled decision citing '06.10 D-11'. 06.10 defines no D-11 (only D-01..D-04), and 06.10 records the closure scenario as an unresolved question, not a decision.
findings.evidence: education-lessons-mentorship-cx.md:152-154 — "A fifth binding surfaced in Step 5: the **no-fault closure cascade** — closing the building (06.10 D-11) forces the same-day remedy on every in-flight series with no notice period, because the room is gone." But 06.10-academy-multi-teacher-operations.md defines exactly four decisions (D-01 'An academy is an **Operator**, not a fifth persona'; D-02 organisation entity; D-03 'The student belongs to the academy; the identity belongs to the teacher'; D-04 'The academy layer is **optional and invisible**') — there is no D-11 and no D-06. 06.10 instead records the scenario as OPEN: 06.10:70 edge case — "| Academy closes with credits outstanding | Prepaid liability meets insolvency — this has happened to real music schools and real parents | 06.01.02 Q-01/Q-02 — and this is the scenario that makes those questions urgent rather than theoretical |", and 06.10:121 Q-03 — "What happens when an academy **closes** with prepaid credits outstanding? ... | User | `/create-prd-security` (compliance) |". 06.10:50 further states "`[PENDING — /ideate-discover Step 5]`: nearly all of the operational detail", contradicting the CX's claim that Step 5 produced this binding. The behaviour the CX describes exists at 06.01.03-cancellation-makeup-no-show-policy.md:253 D-11 — "**No-fault** is a first-class settlement class, not an override ... Operator closure cascades automatically to every lesson in the affected rooms." — i.e. the id is real but anchored to the wrong file.
findings.forcedInvention: An implementer building academy closure follows the citation to 06.10, finds no D-11 and an explicitly open question, and must invent whether closure is decided or deferred — and if decided, what 'the same-day remedy with no notice period' consists of.

findings.claim: education-lessons-mentorship-cx.md CX-13 cites '06.01.02 D-06' as the decision governing credit refund-or-transfer when a teacher departs. 06.01.02 D-06 is a different decision (teacher earnings accrual); the departure remedy is D-12.
findings.evidence: education-lessons-mentorship-cx.md:332 — "Resolved by the invariant that **each owns its own object**: the page persists (01), the vouch retracts (06.10), the credits refund or transfer per D-06 (06.01.02). None can strand the others." But 06.01.02-lesson-packages-credits-rate-cards.md:290 D-06 reads — "**Teacher earnings accrue on delivery or on a policy burn — never on purchase.** Money for undelivered lessons stays with the platform". The refund/transfer-on-departure rule is D-12, per 06.01.02:200 — "| 12 | Student asks to move credits to a different teacher | **Rejected by default** — credits are teacher-scoped because the price is teacher-specific (D-01). Transfer exists only as a departure **remedy**, never as a feature (D-12)" and 06.01.02:241 — "| Remedy | Departure notice elapsed, or involuntary departure | Purchaser: three named options (reassign / refund / transfer) with a 30-day deadline and the default (refund) stated up front |".
findings.forcedInvention: A spec writer resolving the teacher-departure race follows the citation to a decision about earnings accrual, which does not describe the three-option remedy or its 30-day deadline, and must search for or invent the actual rule.

findings.claim: The 06.01 index Role Matrix describes the academy floor policy with the exact wording that 06.01.03 D-06 identifies by name as ambiguous and explicitly corrects. The index retains the superseded phrasing with no marker, and the two readings impose opposite constraints on teachers.
findings.evidence: 06.01-lesson-booking-packages-delivery-index.md:43 — "| 06.01.03 Cancellation, Make-Up & No-Show | ... | ⚙️ Config — as academy, sets a floor policy **teachers cannot undercut** | ❌ None |". CORRECTED BY 06.01.03-cancellation-makeup-no-show-policy.md:248 D-06 — "The academy floor is a **ceiling on harshness**, not a mandate — a teacher may always be more generous | The direction was ambiguous in the original text (\"cannot undercut\"). Resolved explicitly: the floor protects **students** from a harsh teacher ... Generosity flows one way." The corrected direction is restated normatively at 06.01.03:62-69 — "### The three-layer clamp / Generosity flows one way. Each layer may only be **more generous** than the one above it: Platform bound ... ≥ Academy floor (Operator-set; bounds their teachers' maximum harshness — D-06) ≥ Teacher policy". The domain CX carries the corrected form (education-lessons-mentorship-cx.md:149-151, "Step 5 resolves its ambiguous direction: it is a **ceiling on harshness, not a mandate**; teachers may always be more generous"); only the 06.01 index is stale.
findings.forcedInvention: "Cannot undercut" reads naturally as a floor the teacher may not go below, which forbids exactly the more-generous teacher policy D-06 guarantees. An implementer building the clamp from the index inverts the direction of the academy constraint.

findings.claim: 06.02.04 states in its Behavior section that the conversion decision is made in the ten minutes AFTER the trial lesson, while its own DT-02 explicitly REJECTS that timing, and its D-01, Happy Path and the domain CX all place the moment inside the room in the last two minutes. The two timings imply different product surfaces and neither statement carries a marker.
findings.evidence: 06.02.04-trial-lessons-conversion.md:28-30 (Behavior) — "The conversion moment matters most — the decision to commit to a year of Tuesdays is made in the ten minutes *after* a good first lesson, and if the product's answer is 'email me and we'll sort it out', that is where the domain leaks its funnel." CONTRADICTED BY the same file at :82 DT-02 — "| DT-02 | Conversion happens after the trial, via a follow-up email or a prompt in the app | Standard marketplace funnel thinking — nurture the lead | ❌ REJECTED — the decision is made **in the room, in the last two minutes**, while the student is still warm and the teacher is right there."; at :104 D-01 — "| D-01 | The conversion moment lives **in the room**, at the end of the trial | Per DT-02 — the decision is made warm and dies cold"; and at :48 Happy Path step 4 — "In-room, at the end, the teacher can propose a standing slot and the student can accept **there**". The domain CX propagates the in-room reading: education-lessons-mentorship-cx.md:40 — "the decision to commit to a year of Tuesdays is made in the last two minutes of a good first lesson, while the student is warm and the teacher is right there."
findings.forcedInvention: 'Ten minutes after' requires a post-lesson surface that exists once the room has closed; 'the last two minutes, in the room' requires an in-room CTA on 06.01.04's delivery surface. An implementer must pick which surface carries the domain's core funnel conversion.
